title: Extend MealPlan model for text items and typed deletion
description: Add `MealPlanItem.text(String)`, introduce `ItemIndex`, and implement `MealPlan.removeItem(at:)` as the minimal typed mutation surface required by v1.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanItem` supports `.text(String)` alongside recipe and ingredient cases.
`ItemIndex` is added as a public value type with block, section, and position indices.
`MealPlan.removeItem(at:)` removes only the addressed item, preserves empty sections/blocks, and no-ops for out-of-bounds indices.
